findings.claim: unreadableFrontmatter now scans the whole page, with no frontmatter bound and no opening --- required. Any non-legacy page whose frontmatterBlock cannot isolate (plain notes, documents, pages with a different frontmatter shape) is now counted as a legacy page and refused as unreadable if its body has a line like `memorycard_id: 7` or `engram_id: 5` at column 0. Its project may also be taken from a `project:` line in the body. Before, such a page was ignored unless it opened with ---. A refusal makes the exit code non-zero, so a vault holding a page that merely quotes these keys now fails the run on input that was valid before. The doc comment accepts this, but nothing limits the false positives.

printNoProjectNote now runs before the error return and before the per-kind refused summary, so on a successful run the note appears before the summary lines instead of after them. Output order changed. No test pins the order.

evidence: Diff only; no tools used. The base function returned false unless the first line was ---, and stopped at the closing ---; the head removes both limits and joins the whole page.
